preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.system_role WHERE name = 'Validation'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.system_role WHERE name = 'Validation Biologist'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.system_role_module rm JOIN clinlims.system_role r ON r.id = rm.system_role_id WHERE r.name = 'Validation Biologist'

changeSet.comment: Clone Validation module permissions into Validation Biologist role
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_module (id, has_select, has_add, has_update, has_delete, system_role_id, system_module_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_role_module_seq'), src.has_select, src.has_add, src.has_update, src.has_delete, target.id, src.system_module_id FROM clinlims.system_role_module src JOIN clinlims.system_role source_role ON source_role.id = src.system_role_id JOIN clinlims.system_role target ON target.name = 'Validation Biologist' WHERE source_role.name = 'Validation' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_module existing WHERE existing.system_role_id = target.id AND existing.system_module_id = src.system_module_id );
